title: New Rarity Crests & Role Lettering
body:
Hero cards now wear the new rarity crests in the top-right corner (Normal, R, SR, SSR, Ultra Rare, Legend, Mythic, God and Void) and the new role lettering under the element icon: MAGE, FIGHTER, TANK, ASSASSIN and SUPPORT.

On a hero's page the rarity name is written in its own colours: rainbow for Legend, magenta-red for Mythic, white hologram for God, cosmic black for Void, and the border colour for the others. The crest sits beside her name.

title: Nine Hero Rarities & New Summon Hall
body:
Heroes now come in nine rarities: N, R, SR, SSR, UR, Legend (LR), Mythic (MR), God (GR) and Void (OR). Each has its own border and aura: grey, blue, purple, gold, red, a rainbow ring for Legend, magenta-red for Mythic, white hologram for God and cosmic black for Void.

Summon rates: N 30%, R 25%, SR 20%, SSR 10%, UR 5%, LR 3%, MR 1%. God and Void heroes are coming in a future update; until then their share goes to N.

The Summon hall now has four banners: Morana Rate-Up, Tamo Rate-Up, the Standard Summon (every hero) and the new Normal Summon (N to SSR heroes for 6,000 Gold). Pity now guarantees a Legend or better at 80 summons, and the first 10x guarantees UR or better.

The Gallery shows every hero in her main Lv1 art, sorted by rarity, with a mystery card for the tiers still to come. Your Commander avatar starts in the hero's Lv1 sprite; forms open at 4★ and evolutions at 5★ (Profile → AVATAR → FORM).

title: Rows cascade in smoothly
body: Lists that appear row by row (missions, Tower floors, cards, menus) now cascade in smoothly from the first row instead of the first few appearing all at once.

title: Popups open in full
body: Popups (Menu, Codex, rewards, profiles…) now open with their full bounce instead of popping in half-way, for the same reason as screen changes: the animation starts once the popup's content is built.

title: Screen changes glide
body: Screen changes glide instead of jumping. Big screens (Heroes, Story, the lobby) take a moment to build, and that moment used to swallow most of the slide-in animation; the slide now starts right after, so it always plays in full.

title: Even frame pacing on fast screens
body: Smoother motion on high-refresh phones. The game now measures your screen's refresh rate and picks a frame cap that divides it evenly: a 90 Hz screen runs at 90 fps instead of a stuttering 60, a 120 Hz screen at an even 60, a 144 Hz screen at 72. The 30 FPS battery saver works the same way.

title: A soft glow behind your hero
body: Your lobby hero and the hero on her own page now stand in a soft glow of her colour that slowly breathes — light instead of movement, so it always looks smooth.

title: Stricter checks
body: Behind the scenes: the automatic UI test now also fails on stray engine errors, and the layout check covers the BOOST popup in Battle Prep again.

title: Cleaner popups
body: Fixed error messages that the last update could leave behind when a popup was closed quickly. Upcoming birthdays in the Schedule now use the same full-body avatars as the rest of the game.

title: Smooth battle runes
body: The glowing runes under every tile of the battle and Battle Prep boards now turn smoothly; they were drawn at a third of the frame rate and visibly stepped.

title: Smoother, steadier, lighter
body: Smoother everywhere. The game no longer stutters every few moments: a layout check that ran on every screen several times a second now runs only while a screen opens. Backgrounds no longer slide or zoom (that slow drift looked like lag on phones); battle maps now glow with soft light shafts and a breathing light instead, and sun rays pulse rather than turn. Animated characters do less work per frame for exactly the same picture, and on phones with very sharp screens the game renders at 2x instead of 3x pixel density, which looks the same at phone size but is far lighter. The loading screen now shows only pictures, with a small "ketuk untuk masuk" line.

title: Bestiary points the way
body: A foe's Bestiary page now names the first story chapter where she appears ("Story Ch.39 Choir of the Abyss (+1 more)") and its GO button opens that chapter directly.

title: Your finds come first
body: The Bestiary now lists the foes you have discovered first (most defeated at the top) and opens on one of them, instead of a wall of silhouettes with your finds scattered in between.

title: New foe discovered
body: Defeating a foe for the first time now announces it: "NEW FOE DISCOVERED: Lolth!", so you know her Bestiary entry, art and taming track just opened.

title: Three new World Bosses
body: Three of the new foes join the weekly World Boss rotation: Lolth, Broodmother of Whispers; Code Zero, Skull Worm Colossus; and Octavia-Vex, Tide of a Thousand Arms. This week's boss stays Serpentia, so your weekly damage is safe.

title: Enemy cards in Battle Prep
body: In Battle Prep you can now tap any enemy on her board to open the same card: her skill, element and the element that counters her, so you can plan your formation without leaving the screen.

title: Know your foe
body: Tap any enemy face on a story stage to see who she is before the fight: element, class, level, what her skill does, and which element hits her hardest.

title: Enemy skills explained
body: Every enemy skill now has a plain description, e.g. "Hits one enemy (aimed at the back line) for 130% ATK. Heals herself for 50% of the damage." It shows when you tap an enemy in battle and on her Bestiary page.

title: 13 more heroes get their realm
body: Thirteen more heroes now have their own realm (Abadonia, Eropatra, Furu, Glytta, Hyeonxa, Luby, Micca, Ning Er, Rubby, Schylua, Seraph, Siv, Spimei), shown on their hero page, in their memories and talks, behind their rate-up banner and as the lobby scene "Her Realm". 27 heroes have a realm in total.

title: A smaller download
body: The first download is much smaller again: about 136 MB instead of 235 MB. The new enemies (and a few heroes from earlier updates) were stored without compression; they now use the same compression as the rest of the art.

title: 17 new enemies arrive
body: Seventeen new enemies have entered Euphoria: Amatera, Anthis, Cleara, Code Zero, Cow Girl, Graeae, Kurenai, Lamia, Lolth, Nagini, Nox, Octavia-Vex, Rin, Roza Sha, Selene, Veyr-Nok and Xa'niyus. Each fights the way she looks: Code Zero walls up behind her skull worm, Kurenai finishes wounded back-liners, Nagini's gaze petrifies a whole column, Selene drinks the life she takes. They roam story chapters 15 to 52, the Tower and the Starlight Rift, every one can be tamed in the Bestiary, and the Training Ground gains a LIGHT partner (Roza Sha). All of their artwork is animated, and every animated character in the game now also turns slightly toward your finger with moving light and a soft shadow.

title: Where Skill Books come from
body: Out of Skill Books? The Skill section now offers the places that sell or drop them (Arena Shop, Gold Shop, Dungeon) as buttons, like the shard sources under Star Up.

title: Where shards come from
body: When a hero is short of shards for Star Up, her Upgrade tab now lists where to get them as buttons: Summon, Black Market and Boss Hunt.

title: Find EXP and Gold faster
body: Short of Hero EXP or Gold for a level-up? The Upgrade tab now shows a "GET EXP ▶" or "GET GOLD ▶" button that opens the matching daily dungeon directly.

title: How long is left
body: The download screen now estimates how long is left ("±23 dtk lagi") from your connection's recent speed.

title: Upgrade the right hero after a loss
body: After a defeat, UPGRADE now takes you straight to the weakest hero of that team on her Upgrade tab, instead of the full hero list. On a Light or Dark hero's page, the element chips read "RIVAL ⇄ DARK/LIGHT" instead of two chips that looked contradictory (Light and Dark beat each other).

title: Look closer at your pulls
body: After a summon, tap any revealed card to see that hero's full art in the viewer, then close it to return to your results.

title: A no that looks like a no
body: Messages that say "no" (not enough, locked, can't do that) now give a quick head-shake as they appear, so they read differently from good news at a glance.

title: Red dots show what is ready
body: On a hero's page a small red dot now marks the tab where something is waiting: UPGRADE when she can Star Up, BOND when she has an unread memory.

title: Heart Catch picks look tidy
body: Heart Catch's "Play as" row shows each hero as her full-body avatar, with a pink frame on the one you picked.

title: No more half-empty teams by accident
body: Starting a battle with empty slots while free heroes are waiting now asks first: AUTO FILL builds a full team for this fight, FIGHT ANYWAY goes in as you are (and is remembered for the session).

title: Drink a flask and fight
body: Out of Energy but carrying Energy Flasks? The Story screen now offers to drink one on the spot and goes straight into the battle, instead of sending you to the Bag.

title: Purchases you can see
body: Buying something in the Shop now sends its icons flying up to your currency bar with a reward chime, instead of only a text message.

title: A close button on every popup
body: Every popup that can be closed now has a round ✕ button in its top-right corner. Tapping outside still works, but not everyone knows that.

title: See who can Star Up
body: Hero cards in the Heroes list show a small green "▲★" when that hero can Star Up right now, so you no longer have to open every hero to find out.

title: AUTO stays on
body: Story scenes remember AUTO: once you switch it on, the next scene starts in AUTO too until you switch it off.

title: A lobby with depth on phones
body: On phones the lobby now has depth too: when you are not touching the screen, the hero and the room behind her sway gently against each other, the same parallax a mouse gives on a computer.

title: Skip the chapter card with a tap
body: The chapter title card that opens a new story chapter can now be dismissed with a tap, so it never stands between you and the BATTLE button.

title: See what you gained
body: Level Up and Star Up now show exactly what you gained: "+1,133 HP  +53 ATK  +53 DEF" rises under the celebration text.

title: Avatars match everywhere
body: Player avatars now look the same everywhere: the Arena ranking, the Arena defense log and the guild member list use the full-body avatar frame from your profile (your own row shows your chosen avatar).

title: Garden residents tidied
body: The Garden's resident list uses the same full-body avatars as the rest of the game, and its heart pips are clearer: filled pink for taps used today, outlines for the ones still waiting.

title: Boss Hunt list easier to read
body: Boss Hunt targets are easier to read: their names and rewards sit on a soft dark fade instead of straight on the starfield art.

title: Bag and Missions remember
body: The Bag and Missions screens also remember their last tab and category for the session, so jumping out through a GO button and coming back lands you where you were.

title: The Heroes list remembers
body: The Heroes list remembers how you left it: rarity, element and class filters, the sort order and the scroll position stay the same when you come back from a hero.

title: Tidier Season Pass cells
body: Season Pass cells with two rewards now show them side by side instead of stacked on top of each other, and locked Premium cells carry a small mark in the corner instead of a "LOCKED" line. The Expedition hint no longer runs over the top of its bar.

title: Battle Prep tags stay readable
body: In Battle Prep the "YOUR TEAM" and "ENEMY FRONT LINE" tags sit on small dark pills above the units, so a tall hero in the back row no longer hides them.

title: Icons the same size
body: The Festival icon and the Lantern Charm token were drawn at half the size of every other icon; they now match the rest of the menu.

title: A clearer victory screen
body: The victory screen tells its story better: the three star conditions are shown as chips that light up green when met, and your rewards drop in one by one with a soft tick. The Equipment icon (Forge, Armory dungeon) was redrawn as a sword and shield, and the Gear Chest has its own chest icon instead of the equipment symbol.

title: Tap to enter, a logo sound, a quiet title
body: Entering the game is smoother. When the download finishes, one tap on "TAP TO ENTER" takes you in: on Android that tap also switches to full screen and locks landscape, and on every device it lets the ONIX Studio logo play with its own short opening sound. The title screen is now quiet; the lobby music starts once you are actually in the game. On iPhone the loading screen explains how to get full screen (Add to Home Screen), and the turned page no longer bounces or leaves gaps when the browser bars move.

title: Landscape only, like a mobile game
body: The web version is now landscape only, like a mobile game. Holding your phone upright no longer shows a "rotate your phone" screen: the whole game, from the download screen through the studio logo to the title, simply turns sideways and fills the screen, and taps land exactly where you touch. On Android the first tap also switches to full screen and locks landscape.

title: ONIX Studio presents
body: The game now opens with the ONIX Studio logo: after the download it appears, a band of light crosses it, and it fades into the title screen. Tap to skip.

title: Messenger list fixed, realms in the art viewer
body: Fixed: the chat list in the Messenger could come up empty since the last update (the chats were there, the list had collapsed). Also new: the full-screen art viewer shows each hero in front of her own realm, and the Messenger backdrop follows whoever you are chatting with.

title: A proper card back
body: Summon cards have a proper back: a moon-and-star medallion in a triple gold frame over a diamond lattice, instead of a plain star.

title: Sparks and a buzz
body: Small things you feel. Every tap leaves a little spark of light where your finger landed, and on phones the game gives a short buzz for a critical hit, a summon bursting open, a reward, or an action that cannot be done. Both are switched off by "Reduce effects" in Settings. (iPhone browsers do not allow vibration, so the buzz is Android only.)

title: Ultimates get a stage
body: Ultimates have a stage. When a hero with her own realm unleashes her ultimate, that realm glows through the backdrop in the colour of her element while the close-up stays on her face.

title: A warmer welcome
body: The title screen greets you with your hero standing in her own realm, lit by soft shafts of light in her colour.

title: The interface has a voice
body: The interface has its own voice. Popups open and close with a soft whoosh, tabs tick, rewards arrive with a chime, and "not enough" or "locked" gets a low double note instead of the same click as everything else. All of it follows the Sound Effects volume in Settings.

title: AUTO builds a sounder team
body: The AUTO button in Formation builds a sounder team. It still picks your strongest heroes, but if that leaves you with nobody to take hits or nobody to heal, a front-liner or a support who is nearly as strong takes the last slot. A hero who is far too weak is never fielded just for her role.

title: A summon worth watching
body: Summoning looks the part now. Energy spirals into a glowing gate, the core turns blue, purple or gold to hint at your best card, and when it bursts each card is delivered by its own streak of light in the colour of its rarity. A new SSR arrives in front of her own realm.

title: Hero realms, deeper 2.5D art, new summon gate
body: Heroes now have a home. Fifteen heroes got their own backdrop, shown on the Hero screen, in their memories and daily talks, behind their rate-up banner and as the new lobby scene "Her Realm"; the others use the map of their element until theirs arrives. Hero art has more depth: it turns slightly toward your finger, catches light on its edges and casts a soft shadow. Under the stars you now see what each hero is strong against and weak to, and the weather of her element drifts through the scene.

title: New loading screen for the web version
body: The web page got a new loading screen and a tidier front door. While the game downloads you see eight heroes in front of their maps (tap to switch), with a centred progress bar that scales to your screen. Shared links now show a proper preview card with the logo, and on notch phones nothing sits under the camera cut-out.

title: Arc 13 script matches Scylla's art
body: Two lines in Arc 13 described Scylla with tentacles and "eight arms", which does not match her artwork (that is Cthollia). Both lines were rewritten around her masks and her scythe. A proofreading sweep over all story, memory, voice and notice text found nothing else to fix.

title: First-visit guides for six older modes
body: Six older modes never had a first-visit guide: Tower, Event, Friends, Season Pass, Bestiary and Gallery. Each now gets a two-line introduction from one of your heroes the first time you open it, and all of them can be replayed from the Guide Archive in Settings. A few gift items also list more places to find them in the Bag.

title: Bigger tap targets
body: Easier to tap on a phone. The TALK / OUTFIT / SCENE / FORTUNE pills under your lobby hero are taller with larger text, and the whole Gems and Energy chip at the top of every screen now opens the Shop — before, only the small "+" did.

title: Silent failures swept up
body: Small fixes found by a sweep for things that fail silently. Serving a meal in the Kitchen now plays its sound (it pointed at a file that was not there), two older notices show their intended backdrop, and on the Hero screen the name, tags and title sit on a soft shadow so they stay readable over the artwork.

title: Rotate hint on phones, sturdier tests
body: On phones, the web version now shows a "rotate your phone" screen when the game is held upright, instead of a tiny stretched layout; your game keeps running behind it. A rare script error on the loading screen (when the game started in the middle of a slide change) is fixed too.

title: Readability pass: Training Ground, Festival, World Boss
body: A readability pass. The Training Ground is now a tidy 3 x 2 grid that fills the screen, with your best results in the sixth tile. Titles and rules on the Festival and World Boss screens sit on a soft dark fade instead of straight on the artwork, and Date Spot names are readable on bright pictures.

title: Popups that always fit the screen
body: Four popups had outgrown the screen as the game grew: Notices, Interludes, Lobby Scene and Rates. Their lower rows, and sometimes the CLOSE button, were below the edge with no way to scroll. Every popup now scrolls when it is taller than the screen and keeps its buttons in view. The Notices list scrolls on its own next to the article, and Interludes are listed in unlock order.

title: X-LARGE UI size now fits every screen
body: UI size X-LARGE no longer pushes buttons off the screen. The size is now as large as your screen has room for: full size on wide phones, slightly smaller on 16:9 screens, where BATTLE, SUMMON x10 and several tab rows used to fall off the right edge. Screen headers also tighten themselves when space is short, and the Private Room list and Garden name tags stay inside the screen.

title: Layout tidy-up: panels that always fit
body: A tidy-up pass on layout. Panels whose content is taller than the screen now scroll while their main button stays pinned at the bottom, so nothing can end up below the edge on big UI sizes or short windows. The Heroes header fits the screen again, the Tower floor panel has its padding back, and long titles end with "…" instead of being cut mid-letter.

title: Hero Class Filter
body: The Heroes screen has a class filter next to the element filter: ANY, TANK, DPS, MAGE and SUPPORT. It combines with the rarity tabs, the element filter and sorting, so you can ask for things like "owned Water supports" in two taps. Hold over a class to see which roles it covers.

title: Guide Archive
body: Missed what a hero told you the first time you opened a mode? Settings now has a GUIDE ARCHIVE under HOW TO PLAY. It lists all 22 short guides, from Arena and Boss Hunt to the Forge, Kitchen and Training Ground, and you can replay any of them. Guides for modes you have not opened yet are marked NEW, so you can read ahead.

title: Fuse All Runes
body: The Bag has a FUSE ALL RUNES button on the Runes tab. It fuses every set of 3 free runes, lowest tier first, and keeps fusing the results upward as far as your Gold allows. A confirmation shows the number of fusions and the exact Gold cost before anything happens. Runes equipped on heroes are never used.

title: Arc 13: The Jade Masquerade
body: Story Arc 13 is open: chapters 49 to 52, 24 new stages after Arc 12. An invitation sealed in green wax leads to a masked ball where nobody ever leaves. Break the jade masks of the new Masked bosses, Ning Er, Mei and Angela, then find the maskmaker, Scylla, in the grotto under the bazaar. Clearing the arc unlocks the interlude "The Unmasked Ball", the title Breaker of Masks and a new achievement. Scylla, Angela and Mei share the new Story Link "Faces Only", and Masked foes can appear in the Starlight Rift. Supplies are in your Mailbox.

title: Pin Your Favourite Shortcuts
body: The MENU can now be arranged your way. Tap the small star in the corner of any tile to pin it, and it will appear in a new PINNED row at the very top of the MENU. You can pin up to 6 shortcuts and unpin them the same way. Notification badges show on pinned tiles too.

title: Automatic Save Backups
body: Your progress is now protected by automatic backups. Each day you play, the game keeps a copy of your save as it was when you started, for the last 5 days played, on this device. Open Settings and tap AUTOMATIC BACKUPS to see them and restore one; your current progress is kept as "Before Restore", so a restore can be undone. A copy is also kept before RESET SAVE. If the save file is ever damaged, the game now loads the newest backup instead of starting over. Backup Codes still work for moving to another device.

title: Achievement Rank
body: Achievements now add up to an Achievement Rank. Every achievement you claim is worth 10 points, and the Achievements tab in Missions shows your rank on a road from Bronze to Legend. Each rank pays a one-time chest, from Gems and Gold at Bronze up to 10 Summon Tickets and a Special Skin Ticket at Legend. Achievements you claimed before this update already count. Your rank is also shown in your Commander Profile.

title: Arena Revenge
body: Lost a defense in the Arena? Now you can answer. Every attacker who beat your team gets a REVENGE button in the DEFENSE tab: one free rematch against her team, with no ticket needed. Win and you take +14 RP and 30 Arena Coins. Each report allows one revenge match, so prepare your formation first.

title: Hero Service Records
body: Every hero now keeps a service record: battles fought, total damage dealt, MVP awards (top damage in a victory), best single battle and knock-outs. The RECORDS tab of your Commander Profile ranks your top 8 heroes by damage in a new Hall of Fame, and each hero's Info tab shows her own service line. Counting starts with this update.

title: Sweep All Dungeons
body: Daily Dungeons have a SWEEP ALL button. One tap uses every remaining attempt of every dungeon at the highest difficulty you have already cleared, and shows all the rewards together. The same sweep is available from the Daily Dungeons row on Today's Board. Dungeons you have never cleared are left alone, so you can still fight them yourself.

title: Quick Power-Up
body: The Formation and Battle Prep screens have a new BOOST button. One tap shows a preview and then levels your deployed heroes evenly, lowest first, with the Hero EXP and Gold you have, and equips the best free gear and runes on each of them. The preview lists every hero's new level and the exact cost before you confirm, and a toast shows your Team Power before and after.

title: Guild Tech
body: Guild Coins have a new use: Guild Tech. Open your Guild and tap the TECH tab to buy permanent bonuses for every hero: Banner of Vigor (HP), Whetstone Rite (ATK), Stone Bulwark (DEF) and Hawk's Focus (CRIT). Each tech has 10 levels, up to +6% HP, ATK and DEF and +4% CRIT. A tech cannot be higher than your Guild's level, so check in and donate to raise it. Tech levels stay with you if you change guild, and the bonuses work while you are in one.

title: Arc 12: The Dreaming Lantern
body: Story Arc 12 is open: chapters 45 to 48, 24 new stages after Arc 11. Lumeira fell asleep under an old festival lantern, and her dream has swallowed the cathedral. Go in with Rumi, Furu and Mora and wake the new Dreambound bosses: Glytta, Kara, Gemora and Lumeira herself. Clearing the arc unlocks the interlude "Breakfast, Awake", the title Dreamwalker and a new achievement. Lumeira, Kara and Gemora also share the new Story Link "Good Morning". Dreambound foes can now appear in the Starlight Rift. Check your Mailbox for supplies.

title: Training Ground
body: A new mode is open from Commander Lv.4: the Training Ground (MENU, under Events & Practice). Pick a partner of any element and fight for 5 rounds. She cannot be defeated, so the result is the total damage your team deals, with a breakdown per hero and your personal best. TRAIN is a pure damage test, and SPAR lets her hit back like a boss. Training is free and unlimited: it uses no Energy and no meals, gives no rewards and does not count toward battle records.

title: Arena Defense
body: The Arena has a new DEFENSE tab. While you are away, rival commanders challenge the team in your Formation: one attack every 3 hours, up to 5 per absence. Each successful defense earns +6 RP and 12 Arena Coins, and a loss costs 8 RP. A stronger team holds more often. The tab lists every attack with the rival's power and the result, and the Welcome Back screen sums up what happened.

title: Summon Wishlist
body: The Standard Summon now has a Wishlist. Pick up to 3 SSR heroes with EDIT WISHLIST, and half of the SSR heroes you pull on the Standard banner will be one of your picks. Heroes you already own can be wished for too, and their duplicates become shards. Rate-up banners work as before. Small hero cards also show a simple lock instead of a cut-off "NOT OWNED" label.

title: Schedule & Birthdays
body: Open Today's Board and tap SCHEDULE to see everything that runs on a timer: the daily and weekly resets, the current event and the one after it, this month's festival, the Season Pass, the Arena season, the World Boss week and your Starlight Rift run. Each row has a live countdown (red when under a day) and a GO button. The next four hero birthdays are listed at the bottom. Heroes born on 29 February now celebrate on 28 February in other years.

title: Collect All on Today's Board
body: Today's Board (tap the ring next to your name in the lobby) now has a COLLECT ALL button. One tap claims everything that needs no playing: AFK rewards, the login bonus, mail gifts, finished daily and weekly missions, Season Pass levels, friend hearts, the guild check-in, the Kitchen basket and completed expeditions. The board lists what is ready before you tap.

title: 37 New Achievements
body: 37 new achievements have been added to Missions, covering battles fought, win streaks, 3★ victories, Arena, Tower floors 50 and 100, Boss Hunt, Starlight Rift, Hero Trials, Commander level, awakening, Limit Break, equipment, Bond, dates, photos, tamed foes, Special Skins, your Guild and login days. The Achievements tab also has category filters now: ALL, STORY, BATTLE, HEROES, BOND and COLLECTION. A dot marks a category with a reward waiting.

title: Commander Records
body: Your Commander Profile has a new RECORDS tab. It counts your journey from today: days logged in, time played, battles and victories, best win streak, enemies defeated, total damage, your biggest battle, gold and gems earned and spent, summons and SSR pulls, plus a breakdown of battles by mode. Tap your avatar in the lobby to see it.

title: Smoother Ultimates & Ex-Nymph Fix
body: SSR Ultimate cut-ins now play smoothly: the magic-circle backdrop looks exactly the same but is drawn far more efficiently. Heroes' skill illustrations are also loaded while you prepare your team, so the first skill of each hero no longer makes the battle stutter. The Ex-Nymph enemy uses her original artwork again in battle (the distorted battle sprite was removed).

title: Faster Screen Opening Everywhere
body: Screens with many hero or enemy pictures no longer freeze when you open them for the first time. Gallery, Arena, Bestiary, Friends, Summon, Wardrobe, Hunt, Tower, Event, Dates and the Room now appear right away, and their portraits fade in a moment later. All pictures are unchanged, at full quality.

title: Heroes Roster Opens Instantly
body: The Heroes roster no longer freezes for a couple of seconds the first time you open it. The screen appears right away and each hero's full art fades in a moment later as it loads. Outfit lists are also looked up faster everywhere. The art itself is unchanged, at full quality.

title: Even Smoother Formation, Battles & Story Map
body: Second performance pass. The battle grid, unit base rings, story stage medallions and lobby particles are now sent to the graphics card in a handful of batches instead of hundreds of separate pieces each frame. Formation and battles run up to twice as smooth on older devices, and the lobby and story map hold a steady frame rate. Everything looks the same as before.

title: Smoother Lobby, Story Map & Battles
body: The game now runs much smoother, especially in the lobby, on the story map and in battle. Floating lanterns, fireflies, petals and glowing motes, the flowing lights on story roads and the battle grid runes now cost far less to draw. Nothing looks different: every effect is exactly the same as before.

title: Glossy Progress Bars & Glowing Tabs
body: Progress bars now have a glossy finish with a slow light sweep, and they fill up from empty when you open a screen. The selected tab gets a gold underline that grows out from its centre. Locked-feature messages show a lock icon. All of it turns off with Reduce Effects.

title: Touch Ripples, New Toasts & Lively Headers
body: Buttons now answer every tap with a soft ripple that spreads from your finger. Notifications drop in with a little bounce, carry a small icon (✦ unlocks, ! warnings, ✓ done) and glide away when they finish. Screen headers animate in, and your Gold, Gems and Energy chips pulse with a floating +/− number whenever they change. All of it turns off with Reduce Effects.

title: Shinier Buttons, Smoother Popups & Sparkling Rewards
body: Gold buttons now catch a soft light sweep every few seconds. Popups fade their backdrop in and shrink away gently when closed (and now grow from the centre instead of the corner). Reward icons drop in with a bounce and burst into sparkles: pink for premium items, blue for Gems, green for potions and gold for everything else. All of it turns off with Reduce Effects.

title: New Titles, Arc Rewards & the After the Thaw Link
body: Four new Commander titles for clearing Arc 8 to 11: Gatebreaker, Master of the Hunt, Conductor of the Abyss and Crownbreaker of Frostvale. New achievements: Clear Arc 10, Clear Arc 11 and Recruit all 37 heroes (the last one gives a Special Skin Ticket). New Story Link "After the Thaw" (Valeria + Rubby + Aqua): ATK/HP/DEF +5%. Frostbound bosses now glow ice-blue in battle too.

title: Arc 11: The Frostbound Crown
body: Snow is falling inside the cathedral. Four new chapters (41-44) follow Valeria up Frostvale Pass to stop the Winter Crown. On the way you meet Frostbound Schylua, Micca, Aqua and finally Valeria herself. Frostbound is a new enemy look: icy, pale blue and rimmed with frost. Clearing the arc opens the interlude "Cocoa After the Thaw". Also fixed: Arc 10 chapters now have their own ARC 10 tab instead of being listed under Arc 9.

title: Chibi Sprites for Mora, Ex-Nymph & Ygg-Naar
body: Mora, Ex-Nymph and Ygg-Naar used to stand on the battlefield as full-size artwork. They now have chibi battle sprites like everyone else. Mora's 5★ sprite uses her evolved pose, and Ygg-Naar shows her evolved form as a boss.

title: Blushing Faces Blink Naturally
body: Characters with a strong blush no longer blink with a flat orange or red eyelid. The closed lid now uses the face's real skin tone at the top and fades into the blush at the bottom, so it matches the cheek. Fixed for Eropatra (stage 2, stage 3 and all evolutions), Lumeira (evolutions 1 and 2) and Glytta (stage 2).

title: Blink Polish for Every Character
body: We checked the blink on every hero and enemy art. Eyelids now always use one skin tone for both eyes, so a shadow, a hair strand or face paint no longer turns one lid grey or dark (Voodoo, Skelinch, Svormentis, Rumi, Lucidria, Lumeira and more). Glowing eyes no longer tint the closed lid. Skelinch's eyes were re-measured so both now close properly, and Eropatra's and Svormentis' eyelids fit their eyes more tightly.

title: Better Blinking
body: Blinking was reworked from your feedback. The closed eyelid now takes the exact skin tone from her cheek, so it no longer looks like a pale patch, and hair strands crossing the eye stay in front. The lid covers the upper and lower lashes fully when closed. Hair, tentacles and magic shimmer no longer ripple across the face. Luby and Schylua now blink, Evy's eyes no longer shimmer, and Ygg-Naar blinks with her visor eye while every eye on her tails blinks on its own rhythm.

title: Living Enemy Forms + Art Cleanup
body: Every enemy form and evolution in the Bestiary now moves Live2D-style too — 46 more arts breathe, sway and move their hair, tails, wings and tentacles, and 18 of them blink. Art fixes: a leftover checkerboard pattern was removed from Scylla's evo2 art, and leftover white background patches were cleaned from two of Zennyo's outfits.

title: Every Outfit Comes Alive
body: Live2D-style motion now covers every outfit, evolution, special skin and lobby pose — over 160 arts. Whatever look you pick, your hero breathes, sways, glances around and her hair, wings and tails move. Around 95 outfits also blink with the new natural eyelid (outfits with glowing, heart or wide-shocked eyes keep their expression). Alternate expressions reuse the same motion.

title: Heroes Come Alive
body: All 37 heroes now move like Live2D! Your heroes breathe, sway and glance around. Hair, wings, tails, tentacles and chains wave gently, and flames and orbs flicker. Blinking was rebuilt for heroes and enemies: the real eyelid and lashes slide down along the eye and close into a soft curved line, then open again naturally. Tap her head, body or legs and she nods, flinches or jumps. Works in the lobby, Hero Detail, the full-screen viewer and the Bestiary. You can turn it off with Settings → 2.5D Live art.

title: Hunter's Lore
body: Your hunting now pays off in battle! Each Bestiary milestone you reach against an enemy (10 / 50 / 150 / 400 defeats) raises your HUNTER'S LORE against her by one level. Every level gives your team +3% damage against that enemy and 2% less damage taken from her, up to +12% / -8%. It also counts against her hollow, echo, ashen and feral variants. Check your Lore level and progress in the Bestiary, and look for the HUNTER'S LORE chip at the start of a battle.

title: Living Enemies + Lobby Rivals
body: Enemies now come alive! In the Bestiary, the lobby and the full-screen viewer, every enemy breathes, sways, blinks and glances around. Hair, tails, tentacles, wings and fins wave, flames and glowing eyes flicker, and little ghosts and slimes float around their mistress. Tap her head, body or legs and she reacts. The Bestiary got a new look too: full-body portraits in the list, a bigger gallery in the middle and full-body form thumbnails. Set any enemy you've defeated as your LOBBY character with 🏠 SET AS LOBBY. Tamed foes love head-pats, while untamed rivals tease you. Use FORM to switch between her unlocked forms, ◆ VIEW for full screen and ⇄ HERO to bring your hero back.

title: Date Update: Records, Bonuses & Titles
body: Dates got a big upgrade! Each spot now shows your best result with your partner (PERFECT / SWEET / NICE), and the first PERFECT date with a hero at each spot pays a one-time bonus of 100 Gems + 20,000 Gold. After your first date with a hero you learn her personality (Gentle, Playful or Dreamy) and the kind of answers she loves. The plan panel lists the Bond and Gems for every result, your daily date hearts and a Bond progress bar, and your partner invites you with a line for each spot. The Date Album can be filtered by hero and shows which spots you've completed together. New Commander titles: SWEETHEART (PERFECT at 3 spots with one hero) and SOULMATE (PERFECT at every spot).

title: Event Sweep & Clearer Event Stages
body: Farming Event Tokens is faster now: clear an event stage with 3★ and use SWEEP ×1 or SWEEP ×5 (8 Energy each, same tokens and gold as a 3★ win). The next stage to clear glows gold with a NEXT tag, and cleared stages show CLEARED or 3★ CLEAR. In the Exchange, prices you can't afford yet are easier to read and each item shows how many tokens you still need.

title: New Title Screen
body: The title screen has a fresh look: light rays behind the logo, a name plate for the hero who greets you, an ornate TAP TO START band, your Commander card (level, heroes, team power) and a NOTICES button so you can read the latest news before you enter.

title: Full-Body Hero Cards
body: Hero cards in the Heroes list, Formation and Summon results now show each hero's full-body artwork at its true proportions, plus a role tag (TANK, DPS, MAGE, SUP) under the element icon.

title: Player Feedback Update
body: Thanks for the feedback! Mailbox: DELETE READ and a SELECT mode with checkboxes remove mail you already claimed (unclaimed gifts are never deleted). The Daily Login calendar now opens on your very first login too. A New Skin offer appears once a day when you enter (close it or tap GET IT). New illustrated HOW TO PLAY guide on first launch, also in Settings. In battle, tap any unit to see its role (Tank, DPS, Assassin, Mage, Support), stats, skill and passive. Formation: tapping another hero now selects it instead of swapping places — drag to swap, like Brown Dust. The PC browser version now uses the same UI size as phones, and the site icon shows on desktop browsers.

title: Story Dialogue Makeover
body: Story scenes have a new dialogue box: the speaker's name sits on a slanted ribbon in her color together with her title, the box picks up a matching accent line and soft shading, lines have a gentle text shadow, and the ▼ arrow bounces only once a line has finished typing.

title: Sharper Portraits Everywhere
body: Hero and enemy portraits in the turn order, summon banners, rewards, chats and lists now frame the face instead of the body for every full-body artwork, including all the newest heroes and enemies. In battle, the skill name plate now slides in from the side of the hero who acts, with a light sheen, and sits below damage numbers so it never hides them; lobby banner art gets a soft framed edge.

title: Hero Stats & Result Screen Polish
body: The hero INFO tab now shows a big Power number, a level bar, and HP / ATK / DEF with icons and bars that compare each stat with the strongest hero at the same level and star, graded S, A, B or C. VICTORY and DEFEAT titles have a bold outline, the defeat tip sits in its own box, and the defeat buttons no longer run off the screen. Summon buttons you can't afford are dimmed with readable text.

title: Battle Visual Overhaul
body: Battles look sharper: the grid tiles are lit stone slabs with corner accents and a slowly turning rune, skill target areas glow with a sweeping light, and every unit stands on a team-colored ring with an element gem on its segmented HP bar. ROUND, FINISH! and other callouts now sweep in on a cinematic ribbon, Ultimate cut-ins get letterbox bars, a spinning magic circle, light rays and a giant skill-name watermark, and damage numbers have colored outlines, a starburst on criticals, and CRITICAL/WEAK!/RESIST tags that no longer overlap. The turn order bar at the top now shows who is acting with a bigger, glowing card, team-colored stripes, and a red cross on defeated units.

title: Clearer Battle Start
body: The synergy, field effect, links, companion and tactic notes at the start of a battle are now small chips in the top-left corner that slide in and fade away, so they no longer cover your units on the board.

title: Tower of Trials: Stone Floors
body: The Tower climb now looks like a tower: every floor is a stone plaque, guardian floors show the guardian's face, and your team leader stands on the floor you are about to challenge.

title: Expeditions: Send All
body: Dispatch every open expedition with one tap: SEND ALL picks the lowest-level heroes that qualify, keeping your strongest free for the long missions, and never sends the same hero twice. Each card previews its suggested team with a QUICK SEND button, and heroes on a mission now march across its banner.

title: Starlight Rift: Constellation Path
body: The Rift floor path is now a living constellation: cleared floors glow with travelling sparks, guardian floors are red stars, and your current floor pulses gold. The Next Guardian card now shows the guardian's full art in its variant colors (Mirror, Hollow, Astral, Echo or Ashen) and how many floors away it is.

title: Daily Dungeon Makeover
body: Each Daily Dungeon now opens with a banner of its guardian, your attempts left today and your best clear. The level you should play next glows gold, and every unlocked level shows a power bar comparing your team with the enemy.

title: Cleaner Stage Briefing
body: The stage panel on the Story map is tidier: a BOSS/STAGE tag with the enemy level, a power bar comparing your team with the enemy (SAFE, EVEN or TOO STRONG), enemy portraits with their element, and the clear rewards and first-clear bonus side by side, so everything fits above the BATTLE button.

title: Story Star Chests
body: Every chapter now has three Star Chests. Collect 6, 12 and 18 stars in a chapter to open them for Gold, EXP Potions, Skill Books, Gems and a Summon Ticket. Hard Mode chapters have their own chests with bigger rewards, including a Gear Chest. Find the chest bar at the bottom of the Story map; the Story button shows a badge when a chest is waiting. Also: festival sky lanterns in the lobby are now real glowing paper lanterns.

title: A New Look for the Story Map
body: Stages on the Story map are now glowing medallions showing the enemy that waits there. A golden road lights up as you clear stages, a bouncing NEXT flag marks the stage to play next, boss stages wear a red BOSS badge, and locked stages show a padlock.

title: Chapter Clear Fix & Chapter Title Cards
body: Fixed: after clearing a chapter boss, the result screen could push the NEXT STAGE and CONTINUE buttons off the screen, and the chapter epilogue could stack on top of the next chapter's prologue so nothing could be tapped. The epilogue now plays right after you tap NEXT STAGE or CONTINUE, and the result screen shrinks to fit. New: when you enter a new chapter for the first time, a cinematic title card announces it.

title: Tower Milestone Chests
body: The Tower of Trials now rewards the long climb. Clear Floor 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 80 and 100 to open Milestone Chests with Gems, Summon Tickets, Gear and Rune Chests, a Special Skin Ticket at Floor 80 and an Oath Ring at Floor 100. Already past a milestone? Your chest is waiting: tap it to claim. Rival cards now show each foe's element and level, and Guardians pulse red.

title: New Hero Cards & Icons
body: Hero cards now glow in their element's color, carry a rarity badge and an accent line over the name plate. Heroes you don't own yet show your shard progress, and a gold RECRUIT! tag when you have enough shards. Eleven icons got new 3D art too: Gems, Celestial Gem, Crystal, Energy, Summon Ticket, the Fire, Water and Wind elements, and the Armor, Weapon and Helmet gear slots.

title: Private Room: Bond Journey
body: The Private Room now shows a Bond Journey card: Bond EXP numbers, a heart track for all 10 levels (hover a heart to see what it unlocks) and the next reward ahead, such as a new room, a Memory story, dates or the Oath Ceremony. Talk and Rest buttons show how much Bond they give, and hearts float up from your hero when you gain Bond.

title: Arena Refresh & Smoother Web Loading
body: Arena challengers now show their strongest hero, tier, power next to yours, a difficulty tag (EASY / EVEN / HARD) and the win rewards. Your team and tickets sit at the bottom, and the Ranking tab gets a top-3 podium. On the web version, downloads cut off by switching tabs or apps now continue from where they stopped instead of failing, and an error screen has a Try Again button.

title: New Look: Icons & Hero Codex
body: Over 60 icons have been redrawn in a richer, semi-3D medallion style: elements, menus, battle buttons, skills, currencies, food, gifts and gear. The Hero Codex now shows your overall progress and what every step pays, lists heroes with rewards waiting at the top, shows progress on each step (stars, Bond, Awakening) and lets you claim each reward with a single tap.

title: Starfall Christmas: Hyeonxa's Limited Skin
body: Snow has reached the shrine! The Starfall Christmas event runs until January 1st. Clear five snowbound stages, from Snowbell Lane to the Grinch Hydra, collect Event Tokens and exchange 1,800 of them for Hyeonxa's limited skin SCARLET MISTLETOE, complete with a new battle sprite and +10% ATK & HP while worn. The Event screen has also been redone: a limited-skin card that tracks your tokens, stage cards with BOSS tags, and a STORY tab to replay the prologue and epilogue.

title: New Look: Missions
body: Missions now has tab cards on the left showing how many missions you've finished, with a gold pill when rewards are waiting. The summary card counts down to the next reset, totals every reward ready to claim and holds CLAIM ALL. The list is grouped into Ready to Claim, In Progress and Completed.

title: Formation: Team Check
body: The Formation screen now checks your lineup live: full team, a tank on the front line, a healer, every row covered and element synergy. Problems show first with a tip on how to fix them, plus a grade from NEEDS WORK to PERFECT. The element wheel is shown as icons, and the full Tactics Guide is one tap away under ALL TIPS.

title: New Look: Heart Catch
body: Heart Catch has a new start screen: your hero stands front and center while a card shows the three falling items, the reward track (any score, 40+ and 70+) with your best score, and your daily reward plays as hearts. Pick who to play as from the face strip without leaving the screen, and after a run you'll see NEW BEST and how many points you need for the next reward.

title: New Look: Settings
body: Settings now has a Commander profile card (partner portrait, level, heroes, stages and team power) next to clean setting cards. Volume sliders show their percentage with a one-tap MUTE, toggles say ON or OFF with a short explanation, and you can test your partner's voice. Save Data and Redeem Code each have their own card.

title: New Look: Bag
body: The Bag tabs now show how many things are inside, and Items can be filtered (Currency, Upgrade, Chests, Gifts, Food). Each tile is framed in its own colour with a quantity pill, and a pulsing ! marks items you can use or open right now. Empty tabs tell you where to get gear, runes and shards.

title: Full-Screen Character Viewer
body: Tap the magnifier button on any hero page or Bestiary entry to view the art full screen. Pinch or scroll to zoom, drag to pan, double-tap for a close-up, and tap her to hear a line and see a new expression. Browse every outfit or form with the arrows, switch expressions, or hide the interface for a clean screenshot.

title: 4 New Heroes + Arc 10: The Abyss Choir
body:
Morana the Black Priestess, Tamo the Nine-Tailed Sword Queen, Seraph the Archangel of a Thousand Eyes and Gala the Nebula Flame Temptress have joined Euphoria, each with her own rate-up banner. Morana and Tamo also have special Wardrobe skins.
A new foe, Octra, rides her Abyss Beast out of the Necropolis in Arc 10 (Chapters 39 and 40), with a new interlude, Midnight Choir Practice. Octra can be tamed and also appears in the Rift.

title: New Look: Summon & Wardrobe
body:
The Summon screen now shows the rates as colour chips, and Pity and Spark as their own progress bars. EXCHANGE glows when your Spark is full, summon buttons show the gem or ticket icon, and the free daily summon pulses.
The Wardrobe shows your skin collection progress, the stat bonuses (+10% ATK and HP), and every outfit of the selected hero. If you don't own her yet, it links you to Summon.

title: New Look: Garden & Photo Studio
body:
The Garden has a Residents Today card that shows each resident's Bond taps left as hearts.
In the Photo Studio, every setting now shows its current value (outfit, background, filter, frame) and its position in the list, under a hero card with a CHANGE button.

title: New Look: Mailbox
body:
The Mailbox now works like an inbox: your mail is listed on the left with EVENT / UPDATE / GIFT tags, senders, dates and an unread dot. The selected letter opens on the right as a paper note with its attachments and a CLAIM REWARDS button.
After you claim one, the next unclaimed letter opens automatically.

title: New Look: Dates & Festival Exchange
body:
No date partner yet? The Date screen now shows the four heroes closest to Bond Lv.3, with a progress bar and a GIFT shortcut, plus quick links to every way of raising Bond.
Locked date spots show your story progress toward unlocking them.
The Festival Exchange shows charm prices with the charm icon, stock bars, and a daily charm cap bar.

title: New Look: Boss Hunt
body:
Difficulty is now picked from coloured tiles showing each level, with a check mark on the ones you've cleared.
A power comparison shows your team against the target, with a FAVORED / EVEN / RISKY / DEADLY verdict.
The target list shows which difficulties you've cleared, and the Hunter's Exchange shows Hunt Core prices and stock bars.

title: New Look: Shop & Black Market
body:
Shop cards got a glow, FREE / POPULAR / LIMITED tags, stock bars, and price buttons with the currency icon. Prices turn red when you can't afford them.
Each tab opens with an info card showing your balance and when the shop restocks.
Black Market deals show the old price next to the discount, and hero shards show her portrait.

title: New Look: Friends
body:
The Friends screen now has a profile card (your ID, friend count, supports left, points) and a Daily Hearts box with a beating heart.
Friend cards show online status, a heart once you've sent hearts today, and whether their support hero is ready. You can filter by ALL / AVAILABLE / USED TODAY.

title: New Look: World Boss
body:
Damage rewards are now tiers I to V with progress bars, a NEXT tag on the next tier, a summary of how much damage is left, and pulsing CLAIM buttons.
The ranking has a top-3 podium and shows this week's reward for your rank.
Fixed: the RANKING tab in World Boss and Starlight Rift now opens properly.

title: New Look: Starlight Rift
body:
The Rift now shows a map of the next 10 floors, with Guardian floors as red diamonds and your best floor marked.
A Next Guardian card previews the variant hero waiting on the next 5th floor: her level, how many foes and their power.
Floor rewards show your progress toward each one, and the weekly reset countdown is next to your best floor.

title: New Look: Messenger & Room Gifts
body:
Messenger now feels like a real phone chat: round avatars with an online dot, bubbles that fit their text, timestamps, read ticks and an animated typing indicator.
In the Private Room, gifts are now icon tiles showing how many you have. Her favourite gift is marked with a heart and gives double Bond.

title: Gallery Filters
body:
The Gallery now shows your collection progress and how many heroes you have met, with ALL / OWNED / LOCKED filters.
Each tier shows how many of its heroes you own, owned heroes are listed first, and fully unlocked albums get a COMPLETE badge.

title: New Look: Season Pass
body:
The Season Pass track now has a glowing level line that fills up to your Pass level, with diamond markers on every 5th level.
Milestone rewards are framed in gold, ready rewards pulse, and the track opens at your first unclaimed reward.
The Grand Prize at Lv.30 (Oath Ring and 5 Summon Tickets) is now shown on the right, along with how many levels are left.

title: New Look: Dungeons, Forge & Bestiary
body:
Daily Dungeons now show each dungeon's scenery, attempt pips and your best clear. Every level has a medallion and a Favored / Even / Risky / Deadly tag that compares your team's power to the enemy's.
An empty Forge now tells you where to find gear, with GO buttons, and explains what each tab does.
Unknown Bestiary entries now show where to find that foe, her hunting rewards and when she can be tamed.

title: New Look: Guild
body:
Looking for a guild? Each guild now has its own emblem and colour, tags for its play style, member count, the ATK & HP bonus it gives and how active it is.
The left side explains what you get from a guild: the Guild Raid, Guild Coins and a team-wide stat bonus.
You can still found your own guild for 300 Gems.
Inside your guild, the hall now shows your guild's emblem, the bonus at the next level, and a TODAY checklist for Check-in, Donations and Raid attempts.

title: New Look: Expeditions
body: Every expedition now has its own scenery banner, a status tag (Available, In Progress, Complete) and hero slots that fill with the heroes you sent.\nThe top bar shows how many missions are active or ready, and CLAIM ALL collects every finished expedition at once.\nMissions your heroes are not strong enough for yet are clearly marked with the level they need.

title: New Look: Kitchen
body:
The Kitchen has been redecorated! A level ring shows your chef rank and what the next Kitchen level unlocks.
Recipes glow when you can cook them, show every ingredient you still need, and can be filtered into Meals and Gifts.
Your active meal shows a pip for each battle it has left, and you can tap a pantry ingredient to go where it drops.

title: New Look: Tower & Arena
body:
The Tower of Trials has a new climb view: a glowing path through every floor, Guardian floors marked in red and the gem reward on each floor.
Each floor now shows its battlefield, a THREAT meter (Favored, Even Fight, Risky, Deadly) and named enemy cards.
Arena now shows every Season Tier, its reward, and how many RP you need for the next one.

title: Quality of Life: Missions & Bag
body:
Missions now show an icon for each task, list ready rewards first and move finished ones to the bottom.
Tap any item in the Bag to see OBTAIN FROM: every place it drops or is sold, with a GO button.
Level-up and feature-unlock notices now merge into one message, and battle intro banners are slimmer so they no longer hide your heroes.

title: The Kitchen Opens!
body:
A new place to relax: the Kitchen (MENU → Heroes & Bond, Player Lv.3).
Collect Moonwheat Flour, Starberries, Dewleaf Herbs and Wild Game from story, Hard and Event battles, Garden visits, Herb Gathering and the free daily Market Basket.
Cook sweet dishes as gifts for your heroes, or serve a hearty meal to buff your whole team for the next few battles. Cook more to raise your Kitchen level and learn new recipes!

title: Redeem Codes & Battery Saver
body:
Redeem codes are here! Open Settings and enter EUPHORIA2026 for 500 Gems and 2 Summon Tickets. Each code works once.
Playing on a phone? Settings → Frame rate → 30 FPS keeps your device cooler and saves battery.

title: Mission GO Buttons
body:
Unfinished missions now have a GO button that takes you straight to the right place.
New daily mission: reply to a hero's message. New achievements: reply to 10 and 50 messages, and read 10 personal chats.
The Arena screen is tidier: season reward, tickets and buttons all fit on one screen, and ARENA SHOP now opens the Arena Shop tab.

title: Messenger: More Chats
body:
Heroes now text you when something happens: give one a gift, or win a story battle, and someone will message you about it (once a day each).
Every hero also has a second personal chat at Bond Lv.6, with another 30 Gems for the first reply.

title: Messenger
body:
Your heroes can text you now! Every day up to 3 heroes send you a message. Open CHATS in the lobby and pick a reply.
The reply she likes best gives +40 Bond, any other reply gives +20. At Bond Lv.2 every hero sends one personal chat that also gives 30 Gems.
The Bag now shows item names, and empty currencies are hidden.

title: New Item Icons
body:
Twelve items now have their own icons, so you can tell them apart at a glance.
Skin Tickets, Moonlight Perfume and Celestial Gems no longer look alike, potions no longer look like Hero EXP or Energy, and the Gold Pouch, Forge Ember, Hunt Core, Rune Pouch, Universal Shard and both gear and rune chests each have their own art.

title: Scout Report
body:
Know your enemy before you fight. Stage details now show the enemies' main element and which element to bring for +30% ATK.
In Formation, heroes that counter the enemy are marked, and AUTO takes the advantage into account.
Lost a battle? The result screen now tells you what to change, including which hero to bring.

title: Summon With Tickets and Gems
body:
Summon x10 now spends your Tickets first and covers the rest with Gems, so 5 Tickets plus 750 Gems is enough for a full 10x.
The Story screen is also tidier: Hard mode and later Arcs appear as you reach them.

title: First Steps
body:
New Commanders now get a guided path of 8 steps, shown in the NEXT box in the lobby. Each step pays a reward, ending with 2 Summon Tickets and 200 Gems for clearing Chapter 1.
Already past them? Your finished steps are waiting: just tap CLAIM.

title: Four Special Skins Withdrawn
body:
The special skins for Lucidria, Hyeonxa, Kali and Abadonia have been removed from the Wardrobe because their art was damaged.
If you unlocked one, you have received 1 Skin Ticket back for each, and the hero now wears her best unlocked outfit.
The skins of Ning Er, Spimei and Luby are not affected.

title: Gear Substats & Tempering
body:
Every piece of gear now rolls bonus substats: 1 on R, 2 on SR, 3 on SSR (HP, ATK, DEF or Crit). Your existing gear has already received its rolls.
Enhancing to +5 and +10 upgrades one random substat, and Fusing adds a new one.
New Forge tab, TEMPER: spend Forge Embers to reroll substats. Keep the ones you like (each doubles the cost) and compare the result before it applies, so a bad roll never costs you your old stats.

title: The Forge
body:
The Forge is open (Menu > Shop & Social, Player Lv.6).
REFORGE: spend Forge Embers to turn a piece into the set you want.  FUSE: 3 pieces of one rarity become the next rarity.  SALVAGE: clear spare gear in bulk for Gold and Embers. Equipped, locked and enhanced gear stays safe.
Armory Ruins now drops a guaranteed piece of Today's Set on every clear, plus Embers.
New on each hero's GEAR tab: WEAR SET equips a whole set in one tap, and AUTO EQUIP no longer breaks a set you are wearing.

title: Gear Sets
body:
Every piece of equipment now belongs to a set. Wear 2 pieces of a set for a stat bonus, 3 pieces for a battle effect:
Flame Pact — ATK +8% / skills also Burn.  Tidecaller — HP +10% / heal 6% every round.  Bastion — DEF +10% / start with a 15% Shield.  Gale Fang — Crit +6% / crits +30% damage.  Crimson Thirst — ATK & HP +5% / heal 12% of damage dealt.
Your existing gear already has a set — check the GEAR tab of each hero.

title: New skill effects
body: Skills now look different by their area: 2x2 skills rain meteors, cross / X skills cut with twin crescent slashes, melee strikes leave a slash arc, wide WIND / DARK / WATER skills spin a vortex and FIRE / EARTH / LIGHT / LIGHTNING ones call down a meteor shower. Big hits throw debris that falls back down.

title: Battle graphics upgrade
body:
Battles look richer: every unit is now lit by the map's own light (warm on lava, cool on ice and sea, golden in Asgard) with a soft rim light and shaded edges, and stands on a soft contact shadow.
The battle backdrop slowly drifts like a living camera, and bright maps get gentle light shafts.
'Reduce effects' in Settings keeps things calmer.

title: Photo Studio
body:
Compose your own pictures! Choose any hero you own and any unlocked outfit, pick a map as the backdrop, drag and pinch to pose her, flip, add your Companion, a filter (Warm, Cool, Night, Sepia, Dreamy, Mono, Vivid) and a frame (Gold, Polaroid, Film, Hearts) plus a caption.
Press SNAP — photos go into your album (30 slots), and on the web version you can download them.
Find it in MENU → Heroes & Bond.

title: 2.5D Live for every foe too
body:
Every enemy illustration now has 2.5D depth as well — in the Bestiary (all forms), the World Boss, Boss Hunt, Guild Raid and story scenes.
Corrupted, Mirror, Hollow, Echo, Ashen and Feral foes keep their special look while tilting in 2.5D.
Also live now: the Victory MVP art, event banners, the upgrade celebration and the Gallery viewer.

title: 2.5D Live for every hero
body:
Every hero illustration now has real depth: she tilts toward your finger (or mouse), the light moves across her as she turns, and she breathes softly.
Glytta's evolved outfit keeps her special full rig (blinking, construct, glowing eye).
On a slower phone? Turn it off in Settings → '2.5D Live art'.

title: Arc 9: The Wild Hunt
body:
A horn sounds across the Outlands, and every tamed beast's eyes turn green. Follow Luby through four new chapters — Howling Wilds, Serpent Springs, The Puppet Fair and The Last Hunt — and face the FERAL foes.
New Interlude 'Bath Night for Beasts' after the arc, and a 'Clear Arc 9' mission (16,000 Gems, 30 Summon Tickets, 7 Celestial Gems).
Fixed: mirror / hollow / echo / ashen characters in story scenes show their special look again.

title: Companion Assist & Bond Stories
body:
Your Companion now joins the fight! At the start of Round 2 she dashes in and strikes every enemy (stronger with each Bond level) and adds her own skill effect: Burn, DEF down, Stun or Silence.
Every tamed foe also has 3 Bond Stories (Bond 3 / 6 / 10) in the Bestiary — read them for gems, gold and a Celestial Gem.

title: Companions
body:
Choose one tamed foe as your COMPANION in the Bestiary (Taming tab).
She sits beside your secretary in the lobby (tap her for a line and a head-pat), cheers from the corner of every battle, and gives the whole team +0.5% ATK/HP per Bond level (up to +5%).

title: Taming, new Gallery & cleaner art
body:
TAMING: defeat a foe 20 times and you can tame her in the Bestiary. Talk every day, rub her head for pats and give gifts to raise her Bond, unlocking her evolved forms and rewards.
Bestiary now shows every form (level-ups and evolutions) of each foe. Pinch to zoom on hero and bestiary art; tap still plays a reaction.
Gallery: one card per hero, sorted SSR → SR → R; tap a hero to open her album of outfits and evolutions. Hero list now shows 6 per row with bigger art.
Character art was re-cut from the originals: no more missing heads, see-through bodies or white boxes.

title: 2.5D Live: Glytta
body:
Glytta's evolved outfit is now fully 2.5D! She has real depth: tilt her by touching (or hovering on PC), and watch her breathe, blink and pant while her living construct writhes, its blue fire and great eye pulsing.
Set her as your secretary to see it in the lobby.

title: The Oath Ceremony
body:
Swearing an Oath is now a full ceremony: a heavenly hall under falling petals, the Oath Ring rising in a beam of light, and your partner revealed in her Oath outfit.
The date of your Oath is remembered forever on her Bond page, and you can replay the ceremony any time.

title: SSR Ultimates & hero gestures
body:
Every SSR hero now unleashes a full-screen ULTIMATE cinematic the first time she uses her skill in a battle: speed lines, her full illustration and the skill name slamming in.
Hero page gestures: rub her head for head-pats (+Bond), long-press for a close-up, swipe left/right to flip through your heroes.
Tip: turn off cut-ins in Settings if you prefer fast battles.

title: Luby joins + 5 new foes
body:
Luby, the Mecha-Cat troublemaker, arrives with her own rate-up banner and the special skin 'Plush Panther Purr' in the Wardrobe!
New enemies Scomantis, Skelinch, Serpentia, Voodoo Doll and Liza Morph now prowl the story, events, the Starlight Rift and the World Boss rotation.

title: A brand-new Summon experience
body:
The Aether Gate now opens under a sky full of stars, with twin glowing circles and gathering light.
Cards arrive with ornate backs — watch for a purple glow (SR) or a golden glow (SSR) before they turn!
SSR heroes enter in a burst of light, golden rays and sparkles.

title: Livelier battles & lobby gestures
body:
Battle: defeated units now burn away in the attacker's element colour, heroes crouch before they strike, and the last enemy falls with a slow-motion FINISH!
Lobby gestures: rub your secretary's head for a head-pat, press and hold for a close-up, and swipe left/right to change secretary.

title: Special Skins & the Wardrobe
body:
Exclusive outfits arrive: Golden Jackpot (Ning Er) and Scarlet Overdrive (Spimei).
Unlock them in the WARDROBE with a Skin Ticket or Gems — every special skin gives +10% ATK & HP, and golden sparkles in the lobby.
A free Skin Ticket is waiting in your Mailbox!

title: Tidier menus + Commander Road
body:
The MENU is now grouped into Battle, Events, Heroes & Bond and Shop & Social — and scrolls like a gallery.
Event and Festival moved into the MENU and the lobby banner, so the lobby is cleaner.
New in Missions: COMMANDER ROAD — rewards every 5 Commander levels, grand rewards every 25!

title: Dates are here!
body:
Take any hero with Bond 3+ on a date: a forest picnic, the poolside resort, a moonlit onsen, the night market, the starport or the crown of Yggdrasil.
Answer the way she likes best for a PERFECT DATE and a golden photo in your Date Album. Two dates per day.

title: Arc 8: The Gilded Gate + Bestiary
body:
A golden gate cracks open above Asgard. Meet Angela, Ning Er, Mei, Kara and Spimei in their own story — and face Hairly, Svormentis, Ymir and a heartless Mirror Spimei.
New: the Bestiary (Menu). Every enemy you defeat is recorded; kill milestones give Gems, Summon Tickets and Celestial Gems.

title: New faces in the Shop: Grafity & Hairly
body:
Grafity now runs the Friend Shop — she's definitely NOT happy to see you. Watch her spirit flames flicker.
Hairly the oracle runs the Arena Shop.
All four shopkeepers are animated and react when you tap their head, body or legs.

title: 5 new heroes + Special Event banners
body:
Welcome Angela (Seraphic Valkyrie), Kara (Phoenix Reaper), Mei (Crimson Blade Bunny), Ning Er (Princess of a Thousand Coins) and Spimei (Scarlet Spider Engine)!
New foes Hairly, Svormentis and Ymir appear in story, events, Rift and World Boss.
Tap Mei's Special Event banner to watch her animate. Visit Hairly's Fortune in the lobby once a day!

title: Limited events now rotate every 2 weeks
body:
Five limited events take turns: Moonlit Festival (Lumeira), Primeval Safari (Atalanta), Necro Masquerade (Vexira), Starport Gala (Gemora) and Dragonbone Trials (Zennyo).
Each has its own story, stages and featured-hero exchange.
Merchant Lulu in the Shop is animated now too!

title: Lulu comes alive at the Black Market
body:
Night Shift Lulu now breathes, blinks, sways and talks — with new voice lines.
Try tapping her head, body or legs... she has an opinion about each.
She also runs the Hunter's Exchange.

title: A brand-new look + Secretary Moments
body:
Every menu has a new ornate frame, glossy buttons and rarity card frames.
Lists now scroll like a phone gallery — drag anywhere, even on cards.
New HOME button on every screen.
Tap the pulsing heart beside your lobby hero once a day for a Secretary Moment!

title: Arc 7: Ashes of Abaddon
body:
Abadonia's lost kingdom awaits. Four new chapters, the ASHEN bosses, and Interlude 7 "Lion's Onsen".
New Boss Hunt targets: Cinder Witch of Dragonbone (Star Stones) and Outland Leviathan (extra Hunt Cores).

title: Private Room is open!
body:
Invite your favourite hero to the Commander's Room, a cozy bedroom, the onsen and more.
Talk, give gifts and rest together. Each hero has a favourite room where Bond doubles.

title: Harvest Lantern Festival
body: All of November! Earn Lantern Charms from battles, make a free wish every day and trade for Furu & Rumi shards.

title: Starlight Rift & Limit Break
body:
Climb the weekly roguelite Rift and choose Blessings after every floor.
6-star heroes can now Limit Break up to Lv.100 using Hunt Cores.

title: Welcome to Euphoria Online
body: Thank you for playing! Online features (real players in Arena, Guild and rankings) are coming soon — until then, rivals marked [AI] keep you company.
